settings.title: Algorithm & Profile Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize your FSRS v5 engine parameters, manage your user profile, and sync your progress in Supabase.
settings.language_section_desc: Choose the interface language and the language for AI-generated flashcards.
settings.fsrs_section_title: FSRS Engine Parameters (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler)
settings.fsrs_section_desc: FSRS models stability and difficulty for each card to schedule optimal intervals according to your retention targets.
settings.retention_desc: Target probability of recalling the card at the exact time of review.
settings.retention_guide_light: Light study load: You will save daily study time, but forget approximately 15% to 30% of your cards.
settings.retention_guide_balanced: FSRS recommended balance: Maximizes cognitive efficiency with excellent long-term retention without review overload.
settings.retention_guide_demanding: High intensity: Ideal for dense exams or imminent certifications. Daily reviews will increase significantly.
settings.max_interval_desc: The maximum number of days that FSRS can space a card into the future.
settings.fuzz_desc: Adds a subtle random variation to intervals to prevent hundreds of cards from clustering on the same day.
settings.profile_section_desc: Linked to your unique user ID in Supabase with strict RLS security policies.
settings.username_conflict_error: This username is already taken. Please choose another.
settings.promo_section_desc: Redeem a promo code or VIP voucher (e.g. PROMO50) to unlock unlimited generations.
settings.tutorial_section_desc: Want to review folder workflows, AI flashcard generation, and spaced repetition algorithm?
